name: Spendify
description: Spendify connects your personal finances to Claude, giving you AI-powered insights into your spending, budgets, and financial health. View bank account balances, search and filter transactions, analyze spending by category or merchant, track daily and monthly spending trends, manage budgets, categorize transactions, set up automation rules, and monitor recurring charges. Spendify syncs with thousands of banks via Plaid, keeping your financial data up to date and accessible through natural conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Spendify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Spendify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.spendify.money/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Spendify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spendify lists 31 MCP tools, including list_workspaces, get_workspace, list_accounts, get_account, list_debt_accounts, list_transactions, get_transaction, search_transactions, get_spending_by_category, get_transaction_stats, get_daily_spending, and get_monthly_spending.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Spendify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Spendify in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Spendify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Spendify is developed by Spendify. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
